facts.name: Michael J. McNicholas
facts.assignment: Martin circuit judge; profile contains general office procedures and family-related references. Full division allocation remains for county assignment reconciliation; review limited to recurring operating routes.

contact.contact_note: Shared judicial-office/assistant number; email is preferred. No fax published in profile/roster reviewed.

chambers_communications.summary: Paperless office: email PDF correspondence/materials to assistant, with case number/name and matter in subject; copy all parties. Hard copy permitted when unable to email. Keep assistant out of counsel coordination chains.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first; UMC online, special sets through assistant email with filed motion and coordinated time. No hearing time by phone; cross-notice needs sufficient reserved time confirmed.

remote_appearances.summary: UMC/non-evidentiary hearings30minutes or less may use Zoom with assistant notification at least3days ahead. Evidentiary/longer hearings require approval; CMCs in person with parties. Consult linked profile for requests.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word order with counsel-authored transmittal confirming service and agreement/disagreement; motion e-filed first. If asked to prepare order, circulate within2business days and submit within7business days after hearing.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email hearing packets. Scheduling says materials at least5business days before hearing; courtesy section says copies at least2days before evidentiary proceeding. Both statements retained without resolution.

facts.summary: Contacts and basic scheduling, email submission and appearance routes reviewed; specialty family practice and litigation mechanics not expanded.
